dataset: Kobe City public community recyclable group collections
scope: Partial records for selected Nagata-ku neighborhoods; not a complete clean station map
note: These are member/area-restricted recyclable group collections; not permission to dispose of general household garbage. Addresses are textual descriptions from official source pages and are NOT geocoded. Never imply GPS 100m proximity.
